post.description:
``work-case/1.0``: the case, its VEE decision (five tests), read history, events and causal edges, and the
actions it accepts now.
One premise: registers, every read to date with VEE status and revisions, and its cases.

get.description: Run settings for meter-to-cash: JSON Schema (groups, defaults, bounds, units, effects), defaults, vocabulary.

post.description:
``m2c-summary/1.0``: KPIs, queues with aging and daily series, exception mix, cost, carry, VEE precision and
recall against truth, and one status per premise (for the map).

get.description: Prebuilt engine towns available to the operations endpoints (and as static files under /packs/).

post.description: Cost (labor, system, CX), carry and days to release by exception type.
Activity Sequence graph (nodes, causal edges) of the exceptions raised in a month.
A worklist page: cases in a queue (or all queues) as of a date, filtered, sorted and paged.

get.description:
Published JSON Schemas: utility-town-2.0, utility-state-1.0, utility-replay-1.0, meter-read-1.1,
vee-input-fixture-1.1, config, openapi.

post.description:
One complete ``utility-state/1.0`` frame at ``at`` with the run's incidents applied (open switches, closed
valves, leaks); ``premises.unsupplied`` lists customers without supply.

get.description: Default response timings for operations runs (override per request with ``settings``).

post.description:
``utility-timeline/1.0``: incidents, crew jobs with road routes, events, state changes and field-visit reads
for a run's command list. Appending a command never changes what earlier commands produced.

get.description: Frozen street extracts (real places) with attribution and the presets built on them.
``utility-replay/1.0``: frames with one simulationId and increasing sequence (≤ 2,000 frames).
One complete ``utility-state/1.0`` frame (static solver output). Stateless and idempotent.

post.description: ``vee-decision/1.0`` for one read: five tests with rationale, confidence and disposition.

``vee-input-fixture/1.1`` for one month (and portion): the reads an external VEE engine would receive,
with truth stripped.
